responsibility: This file implements GCC’s internationalization runtime support for diagnostics and messages. It initializes libintl and locale state, sets translated opening and closing diagnostic quote strings, records locale encoding and UTF-8 status, computes display widths of translated strings when wide-character support is available, provides a no-NLS pluralization fallback, and builds indentation strings based on translated message width. Its responsibility is message localization setup and locale-aware formatting support rather than diagnostic content selection.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/intl.h, which provides the translation macros, NLS stubs, declarations, and exported globals, this file contains the runtime locale and gettext initialization plus the locale-aware helper implementations such as quote selection, message-width calculation, plural fallback, and spacing construction.
